title: Purchased and then had to cancel
text: They say they accommodate allergies. Register and then immediately contact them. I did, one minute delay. The allergy is mine, if my dog eats it and licks me, I need an epipen. They say they are happy to help but it won’t take effect for a bit because boxes are already repacked. Then how in the hell do you ACCOMODATE ALLERGIES?
label: negative
